sourceTitle: A Fair Mystery: The Story of a Coquette
description: "A Fair Mystery: The Story of a Coquette" by Charlotte M. Brame is a novel likely written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around the lives of Mark and Patty Brace, who are struggling with financial difficulties while grappling with the arrival of a mysterious abandoned child they name Doris.
